findings.description: The bucket has no ACL set and a comment indicates it is intended to be public; without an explicit private ACL or public access block, the bucket can default to public exposure, risking unauthorized access to stored objects.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects stored in this bucket (including sensitive customer data) are not encrypted at rest.

findings.issue_category: sensitive data in public unencrypted bucket
findings.description: A customer master spreadsheet is uploaded to the aws_s3_bucket.data bucket, which lacks encryption and an explicit private ACL, exposing sensitive customer data to unauthorized access.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket holding financial data, leaving stored objects unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is present, so objects in this bucket are stored unencrypted.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is present, leaving data science bucket objects unencrypted at rest.
